_groups.TX: Main planner screen: sidebar, calendar, views, share dialog, contact form, business trips.
_groups.FP: Front page: create/join bar, counters, footer links.
_groups.HC: Small card shown when hovering a public holiday in the calendar.
_groups.UP: 'Next 2 weeks' panel listing who is away, with a copyable summary.
_groups.NY: Plan-next-year prompt and the delete-team dialog.
_groups.ABOUT: About page: marketing copy, feature list (title + one-line description pairs f1/f1d …), data and privacy notes.
_groups.X: Assorted planner labels: PIN dialogs, import, groups, half days, cookie notice, exports.
_groups.V: Newer features: approvals, 'Who are you?' gate, PIN reset, time travel (version history), Team Wrapped (year-in-review story), Today tiles, printed/PDF reports (keys starting rp).
_groups.PROMO: Card promoting Workoșenie, a sister product (keep the name Workoșenie unchanged).
_groups.PAGE: Texts outside the screens: the front page's title and description for browsers and search engines, and the labels inside the calendar feed people subscribe to.

TX.mo: Two-letter weekday abbreviation for Monday (calendar column header; keep to 1-3 characters).
TX.we2: Weekday abbreviation: Wednesday (1-3 characters). Not the pronoun 'we'.
TX.we: 'Weekend' as a day type in the legend. Not the pronoun.
TX.wk: 'Workday' as a day type in the legend.
TX.M: Month names, January to December, exactly 12 items in order.
TX.mbs: Follows a number: '5 members'. Use the form that works after any number above 1.
TX.mx: Shown when the team is full: maximum 50 members.
TX.ed: Label before the name of the member whose days are being edited.
TX.ol: Overlap = days when several people are away at once.
TX.pto: Paid time off = yearly vacation allowance in days. Translate as 'vacation days'/'leave allowance', not literally.
TX.role: Role in the planner (member / approver), not job title.
TX.nextVac: Label before a date: next vacation.
TX.tomorrow: Badge on a holiday that is tomorrow.
TX.lock: Lock the board so nobody can change days.
TX.embed: HTML code to embed the calendar in another page.
TX.widget: Embeddable mini view. May stay 'Widget' if that is the common word.
TX.emailPlaceholder: Example e-mail address; leave in Latin letters.
TX.bestDays: Followed by a year or person: best days to take off for …
TX.weeksLow: Number of weeks where under 70% of the team is in.
TX.coverage: Coverage = share of the team that is at work on a day.

FP.w5: Option: the team works Monday to Friday.
FP.w7: Option: the team works all 7 days (shops, hospitals).
FP.recent: Heading above the teams this browser opened before.

HC.off: Followed by a list of member names.
HC.mn: Date set by the lunar calendar (e.g. Eid, Lunar New Year).

UP.head: Lower-case, follows a date range in a copied text: '12-26 Nov: who is away'.

X.nNew: Follows a number in an import preview: members that are new.
X.halfOn: Toggle label: half-day mode is on. Keep the ½ sign.
X.starts: Lower-case verb after a name: 'Ana starts 14 Dec'.
X.group: A sub-group inside a team (e.g. Design, Sales).
X.protect: Button: protect a member with a PIN.
X.vmQ: Heading of a card promoting a free video call tool; followed by the product name 'Free Video Meeting Space' (kept in English).
X.vmCall: Example title of a video call in an illustration: arranging who covers for colleagues on holiday in December.
X.vmOf: People in the call out of the 10 allowed, e.g. '4 of 10'.
X.vmFine: Small print under the button: the tool is free and calls are peer to peer.
X.vmF3: Feature chip: polls and the raise-hand feature of a video call.

V.wr: Feature name: a playful year-in-review story (like a music app's yearly recap). May stay 'Wrapped' if natural.
V.wrEnd1: Closing line of the year-in-review story; a pun on 'wrap' is not required.
V.tt: Feature name: browse and restore earlier versions of the team's calendar.
V.hmAway: '{n} away' = n people away that day.
V.gtYou: Chip showing who the current user is.
V.inbox: Tab name for the approvals list.
V.apStatLeft: Days of allowance left after approval.
V.pSummer: Playful persona title in the year-in-review story.
V.pSteady: Playful persona title for someone who spreads days evenly.
V.jobRole: Job title (e.g. Designer), set by the team owner.

PROMO.feats: Exactly 4 short feature chips, in order.
PROMO.fine: Keep '€10' and the meaning: 12 months free, then €10 per month per company.

PAGE.title: Browser-tab and search-result title of the front page, about 60 characters: say what the tool is in the words people type into a search engine (free team leave planner), then ' | Team Vacation Planner'.
PAGE.desc: Search-result description of the front page: one or two sentences, at most about 160 characters.
PAGE.feedCal: Name of the subscribed calendar as Google Calendar or Outlook lists it. {team} is the team's name.
PAGE.feedVac: Title of a calendar entry for a person's vacation. {name} is the person.
PAGE.feedPend: Title of a calendar entry for vacation that is not approved yet.
PAGE.feedTrip: Title of a calendar entry for a business trip.
PAGE.feedMember: Stands in for a person who has no name.
PAGE.feedTeam: Stands in for a team that has no name.
